create_PddlDomain_from_yaml: create a PddlDomain instance by parsing a YAML domain file to load actions, predicates, constants, and expression types
get_possible_actions_PddlDomain: get all applicable PDDL actions from a domain filtered by entity constraints and allowed action names
expand_quantifiers_PddlDomain: expand quantified logical expressions in a PDDL domain into quantifier-free AND/OR expressions with entity substitutions
bind_to_instance_PddlDomain: bind a PddlDomain to a RearrangeSim simulator instance to create sim info for predicate truth evaluation
create_PddlProblem_from_files: create a PddlProblem from domain and problem YAML files to parse objects, init predicates, goals, and optional solutions
